datasets.name: LoanAccs
datasets.sql:
SELECT   ac.id AS id, ac.kli_id AS custid, ac.acc_no AS accno,
         ac.NAME AS clientname, ac.val_acc
    FROM account ac
   WHERE
   close_dat is null and ac.kli_id=:kli_id  AND val_acc = :val_acc AND

   (ac.bal_cn1 IN (SELECT accountnumber
                           FROM cm_aginfo
                          WHERE groupid = (SELECT g.id
                                             FROM cm_accountgroups g
                                            WHERE g.iname = 'LoanAccs'))
         )
ORDER BY accno,kli_id

datasets.name: CreditProps
datasets.sql:
SELECT p.ROWID,p.currency, p.boorowerid, p.creditlineamount,
       p.annualyinterestrate, p.annualyoverduerate, p.annualypenaltyrate,p.payintday, p.payperiod,
       p.dateofconclusion, p.duedatefirstcontract, p.numberofcredit,
       p.purposeofcredit, p.customertype, p.credittype, p.personaltype,
       p.autopayment, p.autoexpire, p.usrgroup, p.branchid,p.annualbankrate,p.newfinanceamount, 
       p.numberofbankcredit,p.CREDITACT,p.PeriodContracts,
       p.intcalcmethod,p.activities, p.activities_type,p.status,
       p.pledgsorts,p.aim_id,p.EXPERTID,p.pledgeid_p,p.mehsulid,
       a.booroweraccid,
       a.loanaccid, a.dueloanaccid, a.interestaccid, a.dueinterestaccid,a.iprimaryreserveaccid, a.isecondaryreserveaccid,
       a.primaryreserveaccid, a.secondaryreserveaccid, a.outcollateralaccid, 
       a.outguaranteeaccid, a.OutInterestAccid,a.crdlineoblaccid,a.outloanaccid,
       a.primarypurreserveaccid,a.secondarypurreserveaccid,s.reserveid, s.pledgeprice, 
       s.pledgepricetorpaq, s.pledgepriceev,s.duereserveid,
       b.BOOROWERID as boorid, 
       b.NAME , 
       b.COUNTRYCODE , 
       b.BANKRUPTEYSTATUS , 
       b.PHONENUMBER , 
       b.ADDRESS , 
       b.FIRSTOWNERID ,
       b.FIRSTOWNERNAME , 
       b.SECONDOWNERID , 
       b.SECONDOWNERNAME , 
       b.THIRDOWNERID , 
       b.THIRDOWNERNAME ,
       b.salary,
       b.guarantorname, 
       b.guarantorid, 
       b.guarantorsalary,
       b.guarantorname2, 
       b.guarantorid2, 
       b.guarantorsalary2,
	b.guarantorname3, 
       b.guarantorid3, 
       b.guarantorsalary3,
	b.PINCODE
  FROM cm_portfolio p, 
       cm_accounts a, 
       cm_curr_state s, 
       cm_boorowerinfo b
 WHERE p.id = :creditid
   AND a.creditid = :creditid
   AND s.creditid = :creditid
   and b.creditid=:creditid
